posts.description: As already told, Children of the Gods confronted their cruel sister. Lady of Rain left the other Children. She had no desire for war. The Children’s People one hundred twenty assaulted the strengthened walls. They were thoroughly repelled by magic wielded by Hand and Knife’s folk. They left to gather their reinforcements. posts.description: A messenger came to the Justice Hall to speak with the wise Child God. The other Children knew of the disease created by Hand and Knife. Greedy Noble spoke with Hand and Knife who refused to cure the disease. They sought his guidance for how to handle this deadly predicament. posts.description: Days passed by quickly. Many visitors ventured into his domain. They sought Justice Hall or came for trading. Goods traveled both out and in. Wise Vengeance’s folk now seemed to acquire a new, crippling fatigue. The Wasting Slumber had come to these lands, though it was still mystery.
